in_hebrew.name: Hufnagel
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו House by the tree
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hufnagel הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old German words hof, meaning house, and nagel, meaning nail or tree. The name may refer to someone living near a tree or a house built with trees.

in_greek.name: Hufnagel
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει House by the tree
in_greek.long_meaning: Hufnagel είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Old German words hof, meaning house, and nagel, meaning nail or tree. The name may refer to someone living near a tree or a house built with trees.

in_latin.name: Hufnagel
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat House by the tree
in_latin.long_meaning: Hufnagel est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Old German words hof, meaning house, and nagel, meaning nail or tree. The name may refer to someone living near a tree or a house built with trees.
